files.reason: Corrects retail JKRHeap/JKRExpHeap data boundaries; native linker does not use these Wii split addresses.
Renames two retail bool byte symbols; native already uses the new names and correct true/zero initialization.
Enables Metrowerks file IPA for JKRHeap matching; not a native Clang setting.
Mirror two NO_INLINE annotations and remove the obsolete ARALT class-member declaration, retaining native-width bounds and host declaration differences.

Use actual global ARALT_AramStartAdr storage and upstream disposer iteration. Correct true default already native. Preserve explicit native heap lifetime, provenance, locks, panic routing, finalizers and global new ownership.

No native TU/header/provider for the original DVD-to-ARAM command graph. Native archive loading uses RarcArchive/decompress_yaz0 with explicit BE reads and native-sized indices; no direct change is needed.
